Replied in #coastal-team for you, Sofia: the right figure is 10%.

Bettina's 12% note on Nov 17 was retracted in the same thread, and the 10% matches the signed Amendment 1, effective Nov 1, 2025. The 2026 renewal carries that discount over. I didn't include any other pricing terms, since those are finance figures; June Osei-Lark on the deal desk can confirm exact terms for the brief.
